script.analysis: Full 26219 canonical characters read. A reaction compilation of about 20 social-media confessions (credit limit mistaken for credit, car payments and repossessions, house down payment, luxury apartment, $400 savings, a $30,000 windfall, credit-card snowballing, a South African rand debt, post-bankruptcy debt, consolidation-loan relapse, an influencer-driven nurse, a $100,000 22-year-old, a truck pitch, a negative-equity rollover and repo advice) with narrator commentary. The narrator's one statistic (NY Fed $1.28T) is correct; debt totals reproduce; the truck cost is not reproducible from stated figures.
